old.stated: no expiry of uploaded videos is stated; storage is a prepaid monthly capacity, and when it is used up no new video can be uploaded until more storage is purchased or videos are deleted
old.notes: deleting a video releases its stored minutes; what happens to stored videos when the prepaid storage is not renewed is unverified: neither the pricing page nor the FAQ states it

new.stated: videos are removed if the Stream subscription is not renewed within 30 days of a cancellation; no other expiry of uploaded videos is stated, and an account cannot upload videos once the total video duration exceeds the purchased storage capacity
new.notes: the 30 days count from a cancelled Stream subscription, not from the upload or the last view; while the subscription is renewed, no expiry is stated

evidence.proved: stored videos are removed when a cancelled Stream subscription is not renewed within 30 days
evidence.quote: Videos are removed if the subscription is not renewed within 30 days.

reason: the Stream FAQ answers what happens to stored videos after a cancellation: they are removed if the subscription is not renewed within 30 days, so days is 30 and the note that no page states it is wrong

old: uploads and new live streams stop when the purchased storage minutes are used up, until more storage is purchased or videos are deleted
new: uploads stop once the total video duration exceeds the purchased storage capacity, until more storage is purchased or videos are deleted; after a cancellation, videos are removed if the subscription is not renewed within 30 days

evidence.quote: Videos are removed if the subscription is not renewed within 30 days.

evidence.quote: An account cannot upload videos if the total video duration exceeds the video storage capacity purchased.
